Miss Yonge would be obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](/organisation/111) would send a copy of the [Story of the Christians and Moors](/book/126) to [Madame de Witt](/person/423), Boulevarde Hausseman Paris[^1]


[^1]: Endorsed \'Post Jan 20\'.
